text: Thank you for that information. To better understand your condition, can you describe exactly how the swelling started and if it is accompanied by warmth or redness? Also, what is your age and do you recall any specific injury to your knee?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Sickle Cell Disease with Avascular Necrosis (Legg-Calvé-Perthes disease variant or osteomyelitis secondary to functional asplenia).

REQUEST IMAGES: Right Knee X-Ray, Full Blood Count, Blood Smear.
